Extract console interaction into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Move command reading, scanner lifecycle management, divider formatting, and response printing behind a dedicated Ui class. This gives Lloyd a smaller coordination role and establishes the first clear boundary toward the target OOP design without changing any commands or user-visible output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Encapsulate task collection in TaskList
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce a TaskList abstraction for ordered task access, addition, removal, restoration, and counting. Replace Lloyd's direct ArrayList dependency with this focused domain class while exposing only a read-only view to Storage, establishing a clearer ownership boundary without changing console behavior or the saved file format.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge TaskList extraction into master
commitResults.messageBody: Preserve the TaskList work as a distinct integration point so the repository history records why direct collection ownership moved out of Lloyd.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract command recognition into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce Parser to split raw input and identify its CommandType, with an immutable ParsedCommand carrying the remaining argument text. Update Lloyd to consume this parsed representation so command execution no longer depends on the input string layout, while preserving all existing validation messages and behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge parser extraction into master
Organize Java classes into packages
commitResults.messageBody: Group command, task, storage, and UI classes by responsibility so the source layout reflects the application design. Update test and setup commands to use the packaged class names.
